titel: Hotel near Kasteeltuinen Arcen | Hotel Asteria Venray
omschrijving: Kasteeltuinen Arcen is a 25-minute drive from Hotel Asteria in Venray. Open again from 25 March 2027; what you will see and how to end the day.
hero-sub: Arcen Castle Gardens: more than fifteen gardens around a 17th-century castle, a 25-minute drive from your hotel room in Venray. Open again from 25 March 2027.
hero-alt: Arcen Castle reflected in the moat with water lilies
t3-waarde: Closed now, open again from 25 March 2027
v1-kop: A castle with more than fifteen gardens
v1-p1: Kasteeltuinen Arcen (Arcen Castle Gardens) is a 25-minute drive from Hotel Asteria, in the village of Arcen on the river Maas. More than fifteen gardens, designed by landscape architect Niek Roozen, surround a 17th-century castle. Since 1976 the estate has belonged to the Het Limburgs Landschap foundation.
v1-p2: Do check the date: the 2026 garden season is over and the gardens are closed for now. The new season starts on Thursday 25 March 2027. Opening hours for 2027 are not online yet, so have a quick look at kasteeltuinen.nl before you set off.
v1-alt: Formal garden with hedges, a flower bed and a water feature, with Arcen Castle in the background
v2-kop: Roses, bamboo and an Oriental water garden
v2-p1: The showpiece is the Rosarium, a baroque rose garden with ten rose rooms and more than 8,000 rose bushes. A little further on you could be in Asia: the Bamboo Forest leads into the Oriental Water Garden, with a red gate by the water.
v2-p2: You will also find an Italian garden, a Mediterranean garden, a rhododendron garden and a fern valley, among others. If you bring children, there is a mini golf course, a treasure trail and a play beach. For coffee with Limburg vlaai (a local fruit tart) or lunch, head to the Koetshuys, the Bergpaviljoen or the Plaza Verde Bar.
v2-alt: Red Japanese gate and a boardwalk with a red railing in the Oriental garden
v3-kop: The castle and the Christmas Fair
v3-p1: Your garden ticket also gets you into the castle. The rooms on the bel-etage are furnished as if someone still lived there, with antiques, art and fresh flower arrangements. In winter the park is closed, with one exception: from 25 to 29 November 2026 the Christmas Fair takes place, with Christmas stalls, live music and a light and fountain show on the large pond. Dogs are not allowed during the fair. After that the gates stay closed until 25 March 2027.
v3-alt: Arcen Castle in the snow behind a bare tree
tip: Buy your admission and parking ticket together online, then you simply scan your phone when you drive out. Start with the Rosarium close to the castle and then walk on to the Oriental Water Garden. If you have time left, book a guided tour at the Hertog Jan Brewery in advance, a few minutes away in Arcen.
g1-tekst: Closed now. The 2027 garden season starts on 25 March 2027.
g1-alt: The castle gardens in Arcen under a layer of snow
g2-tekst: Online you choose a date for your visit. In 2026: €21.50 online, children aged 4 to 17 €10.75.
g2-alt: Gravel paths and rectangular beds between hedges and columnar conifers
g3-tekst: On a short lead, for €4. Not in the castle and not during the Christmas Fair.
g3-alt: Wide footpath past a Thai pavilion and a Buddha statue among the greenery
g4-tekst: Four places in the park, including the Koetshuys. You may bring your own food, but not onto the terraces.
g4-alt: Terrace with parasols in front of the old carriage house of Arcen Castle
dag-kop: How to make a day of it
dag-sub: Breakfast at the hotel, the gardens in Arcen during the day and back in the late afternoon for the sauna and dinner.
m1-tekst: The breakfast buffet is served from 7 am to 10 am on weekdays and from 8 am to 10.30 am at weekends. Then it is a 25-minute drive to Arcen.
m1-alt: Breakfast buffet in the restaurant at Hotel Asteria
m2-tekst: Allow half a day or more for the Rosarium, the Bamboo Forest, the Oriental Water Garden and the castle. Have lunch at the Koetshuys or the Bergpaviljoen. The gardens open again from 25 March 2027.
m2-alt: Sunny sandy path through the Bamboo Forest
m3-tekst: Back in Venray, warm up in one of the four saunas. The wellness area is open from 4 pm to 10 pm Monday to Thursday and from 12 noon to 10 pm Friday to Sunday. Tuesday is swimwear day.
m3-alt: Foot bath in the wellness area on the Top Floor
m4-tekst: End the day at a table in the hotel brasserie. The kitchen is open until 9.30 pm, and afterwards your room is just a lift ride away.
m4-alt: Bar in the brasserie at Hotel Asteria
kamers-sub: Then after a day among the roses you don't drive home, you head for the sauna. Choose your room; you will see the price for your dates straight away when you book.
kaart-regel: Kasteeltuinen Arcen lies south-east of Venray, on the river Maas. The map also shows three other places to visit on the same day or the day after.
kaart-alt: Map of North Limburg with Hotel Asteria in Venray, Kasteeltuinen Arcen and three other days out
f1-v: How far is Kasteeltuinen Arcen from Hotel Asteria?
f1-a: It is 23 kilometres, about 25 minutes by car. By bike it is 18 kilometres, so allow about an hour and a quarter. You can hire bikes and e-bikes at our reception. Parking at Hotel Asteria is free.
f2-v: How long does a visit to the gardens take?
f2-a: The park does not give a set duration. With more than fifteen gardens, the castle and lunch along the way, allow half a day or more. After breakfast at the hotel you will be back in good time for the wellness area.
f3-v: Are the gardens open in winter?
f3-a: No. The 2026 garden season is over and the park opens again on Thursday 25 March 2027. Only from 25 to 29 November 2026 is the park open for the Christmas Fair, from 11 am to 9 pm Wednesday to Saturday and from 11 am to 7 pm on Sunday. A dated ticket then costs €12.95.
f4-v: Do I need to buy tickets in advance and how much are they?
f4-a: Online you choose a date for your visit; the ticket is only valid on that day. In 2026 admission was €21.50 online and €23.50 at the gate, children aged 4 to 17 €10.75 online and children up to 3 free. Parking was €8 per car. Prices for 2027 are not online yet; check kasteeltuinen.nl.
f5-v: Can I bring my dog to the gardens?
f5-a: Yes, on a short lead. A dog cost €4 in 2026. Dogs are not allowed in the castle or during the Christmas Fair.
f6-v: Can I still use the wellness area and have dinner at the hotel after the gardens?
f6-a: Yes. The wellness area on the Top Floor is open from 4 pm to 10 pm Monday to Thursday and from 12 noon to 10 pm Friday to Sunday. Tuesday is swimwear day. You can have dinner in the brasserie until 9.30 pm.

hertogjan.desc: A few minutes from the castle gardens, Hertog Jan brews its beer. On a guided tour you see how the beer is made, smell the hops and taste the malt and the beer itself. Book the tour in advance and be prepared for narrow corridors and 144 steps.
hertogjan.credit: Photos: B. Hulshoff and Steven Lek via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0), cropped.

maasduinen.desc: Arcen lies on the edge of De Maasduinen, the longest belt of river dunes in the Netherlands, with more than 4,500 hectares of woodland, heath, drift sand and fens between the Maas and the German border. The park is open all year round; at the visitor centre in Well you can choose a walking or cycling route.
maasduinen.credit: Photos: Lieblingsgouda, Steven Lek, Carelbullens and Jonathation via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA), cropped.

venray.desc: On the way back from Arcen, the centre of Venray is a few minutes from the hotel. On the Grote Markt stands the Sint-Petrus' Bandenkerk, known locally as the cathedral of the Peel, and all around it you can sit on a terrace for a coffee or a drink.
venray.credit: Photos: Dosseman, giggel, WoodenSpoon and Sindala via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA and CC BY), cropped.
